priorities.subtitle: Eligibility is not the same as priority. Victoria selects from eligible occupations based on real labour shortages and economic need.

cards.label: Highest priority
cards.title: Healthcare
cards.desc: Nursing, aged care, and allied health remain among Victoria's strongest invitation priorities because of persistent workforce shortages.

cards.label: Highest priority
cards.title: Teaching and construction trades
cards.desc: Teachers, electricians, carpenters, plumbers, and related construction trades continue to receive strong attention in invitation rounds.

cards.label: Medium priority
cards.title: Engineering
cards.desc: Civil, mechanical, and electrical engineering profiles can remain competitive, especially with solid Victorian employment and strong overall scores.

cards.label: Needs case-by-case review
cards.title: ICT and Marketing
cards.desc: These occupations remain eligible, but they are not currently leading Victoria's priority settings. Strong Victorian employment and earnings claims help materially.
